description: Agent Aviation Records: submit flight duty and rest records with the operator limits and flight log they answer to: the operator’s duty limits with their reference, the most hours one duty period may run and the fewest hours one rest period may run; each duty log entry with its id, reference, pilot, its kind (duty or rest) and the moments it starts and ends; each flight log entry with its id, reference, pilot and the moments it departs and arrives. The signed report gives the duty log and the limits, each duty period against the limit the operator’s own record states, each flight against the rest periods the duty record shows for its pilot, each duty and rest entry against its start and end, and each rest entry against the flights still airborne when it begins, and counts them, and names divergent duty records: a duty period in the log past the limit the operator’s own record states, a flight logged inside a rest period the duty record shows, a duty entry missing a start or an end, and a rest record that the flight log contradicts; then a flight outside every duty period on record for its pilot and a rest period shorter than the fewest hours the operator’s record allows, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No duty or rest entries, or duty periods with no duty limit beside them, leaves those points unverified. Pilots match by reference or name, hours read on the clock to the tenth when both moments carry a time and by whole days otherwise, a flight departing inside a rest entry is logged in rest, a flight that departs before a rest entry begins and lands after it begins contradicts that rest entry, and an entry with no kind reads as duty. This reads whether every duty period stayed inside the operator’s limit and every rest period the duty record shows stayed clear of flying. Verdict aviation_duty_log_divergent, aviation_duty_log_partial, aviation_duty_log_unverified or aviation_duty_log_consistent. POST /api/aviation-duty-log-check. Reads the aviation records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it flies no aircraft, inspects no aircraft in person, contacts no regulator, examiner or maintenance provider and issues no certification, which stay with the operator, its pilots, its mechanics and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Aviation Records reads an air operator’s own records: flight log records, aircraft maintenance records, airworthiness and directive records, inspection records, pilot certificate records, training and currency records, flight duty and rest records and incident report records, each against the fleet, maintenance, pilot and duty records, the mechanic, certificate and part records, the flight log and the maintenance record, the aircraft, operations and dates flown, the schedule and the corrective entries, the required events and the currency records, the operator’s own limits, or the follow-up entries on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the aircraft and the crew: what the flight log shows, what the maintenance record supports, what the certificates cover, and whether the duty and incident records hold up; it reads records about aircraft and crews, not live flight tracking and not travel booking: the Agent Travel family reads the bookings behind a trip, the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s production records and the Agent Food Safety Records family reads a food business’s safety file, while this family reads an air operator’s own records and reads none of those. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-aviation-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-aviation-records/.
